# Mount source for the container's `/usr/lib/os-release`.
#
# The Linux verification route in `bench/stdlib-port/README.md` bind-mounts this
# file over `/usr/lib/os-release` inside the container's own mount namespace and
# runs `tests/stdlib_port.rs::os_release_entry_reads_the_fixed_paths`. It is the
# fallback the public entry reads when `/etc/os-release` cannot be read at all,
# so its values differ from the fixture beside it in every field.
#
# Expected values: NAME `Fixture Usr`, PRETTY_NAME `Fixture Usr`, VERSION `2.0`,
# VERSION_ID `8`, ID `fixture-usr`.
NAME=Fixture Usr
PRETTY_NAME=Fixture Usr
VERSION=2.0
VERSION_ID=8
ID=fixture-usr
